hook: 📈 Jio Platforms lists *Wed, Oct 28*: did you get shares?
tldr: India's biggest IPO, ₹30,188 crore, was bid 22.19 times; shares list on BSE and NSE on Oct 28.

beats.what: Allotment for Jio Platforms' ₹30,188 crore IPO was due Oct 26; listing is Oct 28.
beats.why: Big funds (QIBs) bid 70.55 times their quota; retail bid only 2.72 times.
beats.care: Applied? Check allotment on KFintech now. No shares means your blocked money gets released.

cards.title: 🆕 Listing day is Wednesday
cards.body: The ₹30,188 crore issue was priced at ₹1,065–₹1,119 a share. It drew about ₹7.4 lakh crore of bids from roughly 1.39 crore applications. Anchor investors put in ₹8,109.85 crore before it opened. At the top price, Jio Platforms is valued at about ₹10.3 lakh crore.

cards.q: Did you apply for the Jio IPO?
Which group bid the most times its quota in the Jio IPO?
cards.why: QIBs bid 70.55 times; retail 2.72, employees 2.93, shareholders 7.60 (Hans India).

learn.t: Oversubscribed = more bids than shares. When the retail quota is oversubscribed, shares go by lottery, one minimum lot per lucky applicant.

watch: Listing price vs the ₹1,119 upper band on Oct 28.
